chapter: Family and early memories of Jelly
title: First memory of Jelly and the gifts he sent
summary: At six Jelly brought her a sweater; later a rabbit and a jeweled dresser set at sixteen, which she still keeps.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: You remember, what was the first recollection you have of your brother when you first saw him?

Well, I mean, when I was six years old he brought me a pink sweater with a tassel on it And bought me some high top shoes with tassels and I never have forgotten that Really? And I was, my grandmother made, my brother brought the pink sweater to me and the blue one to my sister But my grandmother made him give me the blue sweater because I vowed to the Blessed Mother Yeah For blue and white So every time I received a package from him it was blue and white Mm-hmm He said, you won't have to wear this rabbit when I was twelve years old He sent me a big pink bunny rabbit That was at Easter time, right? Yes, at Easter time he sent me a rabbit And when I was sixteen years old for being a good girl he sent me this dresser set This gold top studded dresser set, beautiful thing And I kept it throughout the years every way I went, I carried it with me
So that was part of this picture?
